rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight powers
conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused form of siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam with sandhi; equates attainment of powers with the root Kaula

items.question: Is the attainment of the eight powers identified as the essence of the root Kaula?
premises: The eight powers are explicitly named.
Their attainment is equated with the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of mūlakaula in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
